units.source_text: 《十六岁的日记》的“后记”这样写道：

en.t: The afterword to Sixteen-Year-Old's Diary says this:

units.source_text: “我发现这些日记的时候，感到不可思议的是，

en.t: When I found these diaries, what struck me as strange was that

units.source_text: 日记里所写的每天的生活，我已了无记忆。

en.t: I no longer had any memory at all of the daily life written about in them.

units.source_text: 要说了无记忆，那么这些日子我到哪儿去了？

en.t: If I truly had no memory of them, then where had I gone during those days?
And where had I disappeared to?

units.source_text: 我思索着这样一个问题：人是不断消失在过去的日子里的。”

en.t: I was pondering this question: people are constantly disappearing into the days that have passed.

units.source_text: 过去的日子经历过来，却了无记忆，这是不可思议的。

en.t: It is strange to have lived through days in the past and yet have no memory of them at all.

units.source_text: 现在我是五十岁的人了，依然觉得不可思议。

en.t: Now that I am fifty years old, I still find it strange.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这是《十六岁的日记》的第一个问题。

en.t: For me, this is the first question raised by Sixteen-Year-Old's Diary.
